The body extends to the left, displaying bright green dorsal scales with visible black outlines creating a reticulated pattern, and a pale yellowish-white ventral side. The background consists of blurred green leaves.

While some mambas have slight keeling or edge darkening, this perfect 'netting' is suspicious and likely an AI artifact or misclassification of species texture.
The transition from the neck to the head is slightly abrupt and lacks the subtle muscular definition expected in a high-resolution photo, appearing somewhat 'molded'.
